reviews.title: AS3 Area 8 network, system, globalization, concurrency, crypto, DRM, sampler and security
reviews.summary: Implements and verifies the 964 AS3 Area 8 declarations across flash.concurrent, flash.crypto, flash.desktop, flash.external, flash.globalization, flash.media, flash.net, flash.net.drm, flash.printing, flash.profiler, flash.sampler, flash.security, flash.sensors, flash.system and flash.utils in the shared Rust As3NetSysKernel, WASM bridge, compiler and browser host.
